principle: Protect user-visible behavior, business semantics, and security invariants; do not preserve legacy routes, DTO names, database fields, or wire shapes.

protected_semantics: enrollment replay is content-bound
pending does not auto-claim
approval is Owner-scoped
invalid or stolen retrieval capability fails closed
revocation survives downstream provider outage
Owner namespace cannot be transferred by remount
revision CAS and idempotency have one winner
Companion failure does not hide or delete a mounted Device
revoked Hub Device is reconciled without guessing
approve then mount then optional attach is forward-only
partial success is visible and retryable
revoke commits before unmount
two Controllers can resume the same Owner intent without duplicating child mutations
pending enrollment waits for explicit confirmation
provisioning and admission checkpoints are separate
admission retry does not configure Wi-Fi twice
refusal and timeout remain distinct user errors
revoked-but-still-mounted is not displayed as fully removed
accepting a Host is distinct from network join and admission
pending approval is represented without runtime credentials
Hub descriptor origin cannot be silently switched
credential provision and revoke are idempotent across restart
revoked Device stays revoked
provider contract rejects duplicate JSON keys and shape drift
